# Bounded OpenCC runtime
Repository https://github.com/nk2028/opencc-js ; runtime1.4.2 ; npm gitHead ba20c6eda99e7ec385bcf706da2776372675b898. Official tar SHA1 37d29f577df1b6a582a89831523c96ffac089232 verified. No installation/build/test/prepack/prepublish scripts executed; no lock change. No runtime dependencies.
Original MIT core plus six Apache2 generated dictionaries are copied unchanged; explicit hashes in SHA256SUMS. Complete original MIT, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md, Apache license and opencc-data LICENSE retained. Dictionary source opencc-data1.4.2 gitHead4bcdc1064a298884d673dee8bbe91b2508cac6f5, fixed resource manifest references BYVoid/OpenCC025f371dc76b598d77384fbdab90c937471844d8 (source_dirty false). worker.js is a new platform adapter with only s2t/t2s presets copied structurally from actual fixed JS presets, CJK normalization and ordered STPhrases/STGenerated/STCharacters or TSPhrases/TSCharacters. No JP/region presets, TSCharactersExt, external imports, fonts/assets, HTML conversion, models or network API. Core contains unused HTMLConverter function but this wrapper never invokes it or accepts HTML as executable markup. It processes user text literally.
Main thread terminates each ModuleWorker after5s including imports; input20000UTF16/64KiB and output60000UTF16/256KiB. Editing/cancel/unmount kills work and clears old results. TXT/JSON local only. Common simplified/traditional conversion is not translation, perfect semantic disambiguation, name recognition or full native OpenCC extended-config compatibility.
